overall_limitations: All 36 claims are supported by the packet; no exact claim duplicates or synonymous concept duplicates were identified.

Several compound rubric entries are distributed across claims. Individual fragments receive no gold key unless they adequately state the complete entry; this does not make those fragments unsupported.
The claims omit supplied mechanisms including attached-database dispatch, complete status-counter semantics, reader lookup costs, and checkpoint-frequency tradeoffs.
The packet does not independently establish the reported budget exhaustion or depth saturation.
